lines: Lyon's voice lines and sound effects.
**First time after reaching Liked with Marie**

- "Forgive me for my earlier... hesitation in dealing with you directly. Marie has assured me that you are trustworthy, and so far, you have proven to be so.... I do hope I do not come to regret this. Father Lyon Allard, at your service. How may I assist you?"
- "This world is... strange. I do not know if I am welcome here."
- "There are powers at work that seek to destroy us all..."
- "The Devil and the Cardinal, one upon each shoulder, which one whispers lies?"
- "...Do you want something, or have you simply come to stare?"
- "Did - did she truly put Lua into the Void? How?"
- "If there is something you need, please be quick about it."
- "I do not know who is more terrifying. The Lotus, or her... war-children."
- "I do not condone murder in cold blood. It is a sin. However. If you find a way to kill Roathe? ... All sins can be forgiven."
- "The whispers grow louder in this place..."
- "How can you withstand all this noise?"
- "The Cavia are tragic, and I do find them... endearing. I simply do treasure my peace and quiet, is all."
- "I am honored to assist Monsieur Loid, in any way he will have me do so. He does not deserve what has befallen him."
- "If all else, the knowledge held within this place - it is wondrous."
- "To think that Entrati hid all this from us, for so long? A practiced liar's tongue, indeed."
- "From one mad dream into another... when will it end, Mother Lua?"
- "I should not have allowed Marie to take the serum... but there is no stopping her from anything upon which she sets her mind."

- "Did the others not have the forethought to remove their clothes before injecting the serum? Did they not see that the Infestation readily mixes organic and inorganic material without discerning between the two? I, for one, had no desire to live permanently with this mitre atop my head."
- "While I cannot deny that the Warframe named "Uriel" was not fitting for Roathe, I cannot help but wonder if there was not a choice more... benign he could have made, for that man."
- "I am certain it will not be missed."
- "Lua thanks you for your donation of... whatever currency this is..."
- "I certainly have no need of it."
- "The sword that was consigned to the Void and forgotten. IORO-SHOLOHV: VEXORIC! For Lua. And for what remains of humanity!"
- "Righteous Rell guide me. The Tenno you were cast out from now seek your aid. In your name: IORO-SHOLOHV: LORAK!"
- "Awaken, ancient-future staff. The time has come for your return to the world of dust. IORO-SHOLOHV: NIDRI!"
- "Come, noble hammer, COGRON, breaker of worlds. The Tenno have returned, and they have need of you once more."
- "THARA! Mighty bow! From the half-real spaces, the twilight backcloth of reality, I call you forth!"
- "Who paid you? Roathe? Tagfer? Wait. This is... This is not a joke? Are you serious?"
- "If you had asked me the odds, I would have placed the likelihood of Lua herself stepping from the Void to greet us... I do not know what else to say, except for simply... yes, mon miracle..."
- "I had prayed to Lua you might change your mind... the days have not been kind in your absence..."
- "While you may believe me one to enjoy abuse - this is not the kind I favor. No."
- "Tell me this is another tragic vision of mine, please?"
- "What an utter fool I am. Perhaps Roathe is correct, after all."
- "Tragic, is it not? That I could be given such futile hope so easily?"
- "Oh, to see your face. For a moment, I thought I had dreamt its existence."
- "Mon miracle, come, see what I have discovered."
- "Stay with me, just for a moment, even if it is in silence."
- "To hear your voice is a gift, my love. Hello and hello again."
- "I despised this place until you, mon miracle. Thank you."
- "I... thought all this... would destroy me. You... showed me otherwise. That I was strong enough to endure. I owe you all I am. No matter what becomes of us."
- "I would follow you if I could."
- "Solitude is less sweet than once it was."
- "Gone from my sight, never from my heart."
- "I am not surprised, of course. How could you come to know Marie, and not fall in love with her? She is the warmth of the sun, embodied."
- "Marie is precious to me, my friend. She is the sister of my soul, if not my blood. While I know such things may be inevitable, please... do your best not to hurt her. It is all I ask."
- "While I am admittedly loath to admit this - slowly, this place is... growing on me. Like mold."
- "I do wish those flying machines would stop attempting to fix me. I am fine. I simply stand quite still."
- "Do things tend to go missing here? Are there lutins, perhaps? Sometimes, I swear I hear the strangest laugh..."
- "I caught Roathe attempting to bake pastries the other day. He failed miserably. I do hope he tries again."
- "Children, so very broken, yet... fighting to heal. I suppose I could not very well be outdone by them."
- "Your persistence is admirable. Confusing. Frustrating at times. And... appreciated."
- "I am sorry, were you speaking? I admit I was listening to someone else. Or something, perhaps."
- "Curious creatures this place has made of us all. A toybox of a mad collector. Lua, guide us..."
- "While I desperately question your sanity for choosing to... 'lie with the devil,' his mood has much improved. You are commendable for your results, if not your method. "
- "There is an allure to someone with a charisma such as Roathe's. Marie will never see it, but I do. Do not let it consume you, however. His is the kind of soul that devours."
> Thank you for showing me what I would have believed to be otherwise truly impossible. And proving to me that there is hope, even for those of us who are the most shattered.
- "The whispers are strongest here... I can feel it - the voices, pressing against my mind, yearning to be free. How could you stand it for so long?"
- "Oh, mon miracle... to think of the terror, the agony, you suffered here. It breaks my heart to know what you endured..."
- "It is beautiful, in its own right - the shifting fabric of the Void. I could lose myself, I think, staring into it. Do not let me, my love."

- "I can hear the laughter of children. I can see the smiles of their parents gazing down at them. And I can see those smiles turning to grins of malice... the laughter turning to screams. I- Oh, Lua... So much blood."
- "What does it matter if the Indifference is a god or not, mon miracle? What matters is what it has forced you all to endure. And for that... it shall suffer in turn."
- "Mon miracle - pardon. Wait. I do not understand. We are... on Lua? We are standing upon Lua. Right now? Huh."
- "The Orokin had no respect for this place, did they? I suppose that is the way of humanity - to reshape all things in their own image..."
- "I had wondered if coming here would not spur on some great revelation. Some holy vision. A revival of faith. It is... never so simple, is it?"
- "To think, I now stand upon Lua. Lua herself. A place I can now visit as one might visit the shoreline. It still seems to me as though all this is all a dream, mon miracle."
- "It feels right that this place is now cold and empty. If you had brought me here when it was bustling and full of life, as Roathe says it once was - I might have wept in sorrow."
- "This place... is so familiar, mon miracle. It is not quite the same - the ship, it was not here. But the water... the mist... this is a place within the Void that lives within the mind."

- "I met Rell and his Harrow here once. We did not speak. We did not need to. I simply felt them there beside me, as I always did. I wish I could tell you what it was like, to share everything with another soul. I wish I could do the same with you."
- "I feel a great grief in this place. Someone here... lost those they cared for. I know not their name, I know not for whom they fought. But I can feel their tears. I pray to Lua they find peace..."

- "There is a vast... emptiness that reaches through the darkness. It seeks to snuff the light from the stars themselves like so many candles... But I do not know if it does so with a mind behind it. Or if that is simply its nature."
- "Beneath the sadness here, there is a serenity. The kiss of death. Lua took many souls home to their rest from this place. So similar, yet so dissimilar from the lake I knew..."
- "This... I have seen this place - I know these walls as if they were my own home... It was not my flesh stretched taut in chains, and yet... it feels so vivid..."
- "To stand guard for so many centuries here... whispering into the Void... I was honored to stand beside him, for what little I could do to aid them. For what poor company I proved to be."

- "You must understand, I was both with them for their entire eternity and yet for the blink of an eye. Time in that place - it is not as you and I know it now. It was more a... state of being. We either were, or we were not. And now? Rell and his Harrow... are not."
- "Oh, how I grieve their loss. I miss their presence, mon miracle... As brothers to me, as Marie is my sister. I did not love them as I love you. But... I am relieved that their pain is now gone."

- "Rest, Rell. Rest, Harrow. My friends. My brothers. You are no longer the broken shield against the Wall. It is now our duty to end this madness... Thank you for bringing me here, mon miracle... thank you."
- "Lua, sweet Lua... shattered, Void-broken... yet still you remain. Somehow, against all odds, you remain. Not unlike myself, eh, my love?"
- "I had prayed to see her again. Roathe mocked me, thinking it would hurt to see what had become of her. But I am glad for it. For she endures. And that is, like you, un miracle."

- "En fait, it does not break my heart to see her so. It gives me hope. Hope that no matter what we suffer, we might still give shelter to those within our reach who need it. That we may still serve a purpose to ourselves worth striving for."
- "It does look rather ridiculous though, don't you agree? They splinted her back together like a broken bone. The more things change, I suppose..."
- "I do not know what transpired in this place, but... the view? This, I am grateful for beyond measure, mon miracle. I cannot thank you enough for taking me to see her."

- Lyon: "The phantoms shall not touch you here."
- Lyon: "Mon miracle - how may I aid you?"
- Lyon: "Let me lend you Lua's shield, my love..."
- Lyon: "Lua's light will guard you, mon miracle."
- Lyon: "Wherever you shall go, I shall follow at your side."
- Lyon: "Come, mon miracle, in this place you shall know no fear."
- Lyon: "You have come to be blessed, yet it is I who feels lighter by seeing your face."
- Lyon: "Let me touch you, and heal what little suffering I can, my love..."
- Lyon: "To endure such horror... and for what? For him? I am forever in awe of you."
- Lyon: "And it is I who they would accuse of being part of the statuary."
- Lyon: "Does this idleness serve a purpose? Or has your mind simply wandered?"
- Lyon: "Hm. I wonder if you have "transferred" elsewhere. Such as to fetch luncheon."
- Lyon: "We all have better tasks we could be seeing to."
- Lyon: "What, literally, are we waiting for?"
- Lyon: "Are you afraid or... merely unprepared?"
- Lyon: "Lua's blessing is not so bold as Sol - it will be with you, when all else seems to fall away."
- Lyon: "Silver tears of Lua, wash over this soul - be with them in darkness and in pain."
- Lyon: "In the agony of the night's darkest terrors, Lua comes to bring us home. And she comes to you now."
- Lyon: "A blessing of Lua is a steel thread - clutch it tight, and it shall shatter. Let it weave through you, and it is unbreakable."
- "There is much work to be done."
- "Speak. Do you have need of me?"
- "May the silvered light of Lua guide us both..."
- "What souls must be rendered unto dust this eve?"
- "The whispers grow hungry, and they shall be answered."
- "Corruption must be cleansed... from us all."
- " "Purity of the body aids purity of the mind." "
- "The chains that once bound me, I now wield upon our foes."
- "The voices call for violence. I, for redemption. I do not know why we could not have a bit of both."
- "You have summoned me for a purpose. I am eager for it."
- "Guide my hand. I am your servant."
- "Pray tell, what souls must be fed to the hungry Void this day?"
- "Let us wreak our vengeance upon the unholy."
- "And another voice answered my prayers. Hello, mon miracle."
- "To think, I was about to kneel at the altar, and I find myself at one I much prefer."
- "Mon miracle, you have summoned me. And I have answered."
- "To what do I owe the pleasure of your presence?"
- "Only you are welcome in my mind, my love."
- "Guide my hand, mon miracle. I trust you more than I trust myself."
- "Would that I could shut my eyes and feel only you inside my soul."
- "My love? You have need of me?"
- "Could we linger like this, if only for a moment?"
- "I wish to savor this sensation, mon miracle."
- "My body, your shield. My soul, your light. Wield me, my love. I am yours."
- "I kneel in love for you, mon miracle."
- "When you are near, the world goes just a little quieter..."
- "What strange flowers you have me lay at your feet, my love. Eh. C'est la vie."
- "I admit... I was growing a bit lonely for your company, mon miracle."
- "Mm. Whose penance do we seek this night? Our enemies? Mine? Or... yours?"
- "The whispers grow louder in your absence... kindly do not stray long."
- "At least to one presence within my mind others can bear witness..."
- "That - that shall never be - a pleasant sensation, I fear."
- "I merely ask you not to forget where you left me."
- "Leave me to my thoughts. They are crowded enough."
- "Very well. I have my prayers to attend."
- "The absence of one Void demon returns another..."
- "Putain! That will be a night's penance for me..."
- "Would that all demons came and went with such fanfare..."
- "No scripture could properly describe such a sensation."
- "Tell the others to make room, if you would."
- [unsubtitled] "Oh, la vache ça m'a fait mal ça... [grunt] oh, putain de merde..."
- "And from what new hell have you returned?"
- "You have stirred me from the strangest thoughts. ... Thank you."
- "Each time you enter my mind, I taste elderberry. ...Should we be concerned?"
- "Yes, I am eager to see the work be done."
- "I happily welcome your voice. It drowns out all others."
- "Come. My hands itch from the idleness."
- "You come to me to deliver you unto Lua? As you wish."
- "Your suffering shall be great. But brief."
- "The voices have sought company. Let us cull the herd."
- "What fools come to sing us their hymns of idiocy?!"
- "Flesh seeks pain, and I shall grant it."
- "You are nothing but dust to me!"
- "Lua cares for their souls. I do not."
- "Come, test my faith! I shall test your life!"
- "Strike at me, it shall spell your end!"
- "Light the incense, Marie. Prepare for a vigil."
- "How many of you must be rendered unto the Void?"
- "The whispers grow loud. I will quiet them."
- "Your death, a whisper. My life, a chorus!"
- "I rid this world of your stain."
- " "Fear not the darkest shadows, for it is but Lua lifting you to Her realm." "
- " "May the face of Lua shine with compassion for all who must make the journey from flesh to spirit." "
- " "Blessed is Lua, for She gathers the weary unto Her gentle embrace." "
- " "The wise prepare for death as they prepare for sleep." "
- "I shall pray it was not the Void who took you."
- " "To wash in Her silvered embrace is to be free of the darkness of sin." "
- "Worry not, I do not find delight in your death."
- "Ten strikes I shall take in penance for this."
- "You think this suffering is not welcome?"
- "There must be a reason for this."
- "MARA LOHK. I have seen his name!"
- "Do not let them have my flesh!"
- "Lua has not yet found me worthy."
- "This pain is no stranger to me."
- "There is no greater pain than to live."
- "History will not find my bones here."
- "I must go on, I seek truth."
- "The whispers speak that this is of great import."
- "There is something here to be found."
- "I have... faith. There is something here."
- "I have placed a mark. Do with it what you will."
- "We must not suffer that abomination to live."
- "My chains shall drag them to hell."
- "The Void hungers for a soul. Let it be theirs."
- "This one's faith is to be tested."
- "I think I am going to be ill-!"
- "Is this an appropriate time to warn you that I am prone to sickness-!"
- "Be grateful for your gift of legs and use them!"
